source: Federal Aviation Administration - U.S. Civil Airmen Statistics 2025
description: Annual count of estimated active airmen certificates held as of December 31 each year. Covers all certificate categories including student, recreational, private, commercial, airline transport, and non-pilot certificates (mechanics, dispatchers, etc.).
note: An active airman is one who held a valid medical certificate or who exercised the privileges of their pilot certificate and had a current flight review within the previous 24 calendar months.
